summary: Cold read of the ask-reopen-saved-report plan draft. Four findings. The blocking one is that the settled access-only clearing rule could not be implemented at all: a revoked domain or measure grant returns not_supported, and so do 'no mapping configured' and 'no periods loaded', with no reason code on the response to tell them apart. The human chose to narrow the rule to the two signals the client can trust and log the residual gap as D-0048, rather than turn a frontend fix into a shared-contract change. The read also caught the plan citing three DEFERRALS as decisions, and a Verify Plan that named no leaves for the criteria most able to pass by accident.
gaps: Surface Impact marked Docs as Changed while no task owned any documentation edit; the confirmed spec already carries the behaviour.

The Decisions section mis-cited DEFERRALS as decisions: D-0006 is the prettier-ignore rule and D-0024/D-0031 are the proof rules, while decisions 0006 and 0024 are entirely different records (frontend-fresh-backend-vendor, and the drill-down client projection).

The Verify Plan said only 'hermetic frontend tests' and named no leaves, leaving the criteria most likely to pass by accident unproven: pending BEFORE the response resolves, most-recent match, both entry points, busy-no-navigation, scrollIntoView, and terminal 401/403.
contradictions: C7 could not honour the settled access-only rule with the current contract. A revoked domain or measure grant returns not_supported (chat.service.ts:245), and so do 'no mapping configured' (:337) and 'no periods loaded'; the response carries only a responseClass and human copy, with no stable reason code (contract/src/api.ts:515). Clearing on every not_supported would therefore wipe good answers for reasons that say nothing about entitlement - the opposite of what the human chose.
resolutions: Docs is reclassified Unchanged by design with the reason stated.
The Decisions section now names D-0006 and D-0024/D-0031 as deferrals and says plainly that the first draft mis-cited them as decisions; only 0019 and 0028 are cited as decisions.

Verify Plan now names eight specific leaves, each chosen because it can pass by accident, including that not_supported KEEPS the answer - the compromise a later reader is most likely to 'fix' without knowing why - and that the shipped period-control leaf passes unmodified.

HUMAN ROUND: narrow the rule rather than grow the story. C7 now clears ONLY on blocked_by_policy and a terminal 401/403 - the two signals the client can actually trust - and explicitly KEEPS the answer on not_supported, with the reasoning written into the criterion so it is not mistaken for an oversight. The residual gap, that losing one measure's grant leaves stale numbers until reload, is recorded as deferral D-0048 with a trigger. The alternative, a typed refusal reason on the shared chat response, was rejected as turning a frontend fix into a fullstack contract change. Terminal 401/403 uses generic copy because ApiError retains only the status.
